description:
About OpenRouter

OpenRouter is the leading AI routing and infrastructure layer that enterprises use to access, manage, and optimize the best large language models across providers—without lock-in, capacity constraints, or unnecessary cost. We power the most advanced AI teams in the world by giving them the flexibility to move fast, scale confidently, and stay future-proof as models evolve.

As enterprise adoption of AI accelerates, OpenRouter sits at the center of how organizations operationalize LLMs across research, product, and production workloads.

About the role

OpenRouter’s Trust and Safety work has two complementary sides: protecting model providers from abuse and helping legitimate customers work through provider safeguards. As Trust and Safety Lead, you’ll focus on the customer side: ensuring safety-related blocks are appropriate, helping customers address underlying issues, and coordinating resolution with model providers.

You’ll build the operating model as you go, balancing customer experience with effective abuse protections. You’ll partner closely with Customer Success and work across provider-facing Trust and Safety, Engineering, Product, Legal, Security, and Operations, as well as with model providers and customers.

What you’ll do

  • Investigate restrictions: Partner with Customer Success to assess safety-related blocks, explain underlying issues to customers, and coordinate remediation or appeals with model providers.

  • Assess risk: Combine customer context with identity, payment, usage, and provider signals to distinguish legitimate activity from abuse and recommend proportionate interventions.

  • Own complex cases: Lead customer cases through resolution, turning issues into evidence-backed provider escalations and provider requirements into actionable customer guidance. Keep customers informed throughout.

  • Coordinate with providers: Work with provider-facing Trust and Safety and model providers to resolve disputed restrictions, coordinate remediation and appeals, and share emerging threats without weakening abuse protections.

  • Improve controls: Partner with Engineering and Product on case visibility, enforcement tooling, and auditability. Work with Legal and provider-facing Trust and Safety on sanctions, export-control, fraud, and other compliance requirements affecting customer access.

  • Build scalable operations: Build workflows while running them. Turn recurring customer issues and emerging abuse patterns into tools, guidance, and processes that reduce avoidable blocks and repeated escalations.

  • Develop AI workflows: Build and refine artificial intelligence (AI) agent workflows for triage, investigation, case summaries, and follow-up, applying human judgment to sensitive enforcement decisions.

  • Define success: Establish customer escalation paths and measure timely resolution, fewer incorrect or avoidable blocks, successful customer remediation, and fewer recurring issues while maintaining effective abuse protections.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Trust and Safety, fraud, risk, compliance, platform integrity, or enforcement, including building or scaling programs in a technology environment.

  • Strong judgment in abuse investigations, policy enforcement, and appeals. You can distinguish legitimate customer activity from harmful behavior and explain decisions clearly.

  • Experience translating legal, regulatory, risk, or provider requirements into practical product controls and operating processes.

  • Experience using data to investigate customer issues and improve risk, escalation, and enforcement workflows. You enjoy using AI agents to improve processes and have built or adapted agent-powered workflows.

  • Experience partnering with Engineering and Product to turn operational insights into technical requirements and scalable systems.

  • Strong communication and judgment when balancing user experience, growth, legal obligations, and risk in ambiguous situations.

  • Comfort operating without a playbook as AI attack vectors and abuse patterns evolve. You enjoy investigating unfamiliar problems, making judgments with incomplete information, and adapting as new evidence emerges.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with AI or machine learning platforms, large language model infrastructure, model-provider policies, content safety, inference abuse, or emerging AI regulation.

  • Experience with developer platforms, application programming interfaces, marketplaces, cloud infrastructure, payments, or other multi-party ecosystems.

  • Experience building risk or enforcement systems that combine identity, payment, usage, behavioral, and third-party signals.

  • Experience building or leading an early Trust and Safety, risk, or compliance team.

Pay and Benefits

The range listed on this page is the role’s annual base salary range. This range may vary depending on the candidate’s location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.


Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed on this page will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but still are interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for someone who is excited to join the team.
